/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import os, shutil, subprocess

archive = Path.cwd() / 'release/engineering-tally-fixture-1.1.0.tgz'
with TemporaryDirectory(dir=Path.cwd(), prefix='.tally-acceptance-') as directory:
    shutil.copyfile(archive, Path(directory) / archive.name)
    env = dict(os.environ, npm_config_cache=str(Path(directory) / 'cache'))
    subprocess.run(['npm', 'install', '--offline', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-audit', '--no-fund', './' + archive.name], cwd=directory, env=env, check=True)
    for args in (['--version'], ['sum','2','3','--machine'], ['sum','bad','--machine']):
        result = subprocess.run(['./node_modules/.bin/tally', *args], cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(f'{args}: exit={result.returncode}, stdout={result.stdout"'!r}, stderr={result.stderr!r}'"')
PY"
